request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect Technical Steering Committee Support for 12 months across community engagement, protocol governance, and independent technical review activities.

claims.claim: Intersect's Technical Steering Committee requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, to support activities for 12 months.
The budget is allocated as 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3.
The proposal states that all expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds will be returned to the Cardano treasury.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal claims the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Independent audits and assurance for the proposal will be provided by Appold, potentially including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

The Technical Steering Committee says it has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees disclose 22,385,000 ADA in prior treasury funding through listed governance actions.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, a Project-Specific Smart Contract, defined admin and leadership roles, and an external Oversight Committee of six entities.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is presented as available for community auditing and on-chain tracking of withdrawn ADA related to this proposal.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support, provides a work-package budget, names governance and smart-contract controls, references external voting/audit materials, and asserts accounting, assurance, and return of unspent funds, while the deterministic assessment identifies missing treasury, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode analysis.
